text: Added to S24 (from S6, ticket 14): .plot-pane:focus-within (studio-plot.css ~:30) and .explore-stage:focus-within (studio-explore.css ~:94) still draw the accent pane border when a canvas is CLICKED. §15 makes focus rings keyboard-only, so gate them with a code pseudo-class (e.g. keyboard-within) set when a descendant holds focusVisible focus or a roving key operated it (MarkInputAdapter.showFocus). A11yRenderSuite counts canvas stops via these borders: keep it honest (simulate the pseudo-class like :focus-visible).
